# Beeminder

Beeminder is an online goal-tracking service that uses financial incentives-pledge money on your objectives and forfeit it if you don’t keep up-to help you achieve your goals.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/beeminder/.

## Actions

- **Authenticate and Redirect User** (read-only): Authenticate a user and redirect them to a given url.
- **Create Charge**: Create a new charge for a user.
- **Get all goals**: Retrieve all goals for a specified user.
- **Get Archived Goals**: Retrieve archived goals for a specified user.
- **Get Beeminder User Information**: Retrieve information about a specified beeminder user.
